Privacy

Last updated: 11 October 2026. This page describes how the current MindKosh Pixora tools handle your data.

Files and tool inputs

Image editing, passport photos, PDF tools, OCR, text tools and calculators process inputs in your browser. These tools do not upload your documents to our server. Downloaded results are saved by your browser to your device. Reloading or leaving a tool clears its active inputs; downloaded files remain on your device.

Background removal, OCR and browser models

Background-removal and OCR models are downloaded from this site and run locally. Your browser may cache model files. On-device translation uses a supported browser's own translation models and may need a model download; document text is processed on your device.

Optional online translation

If you choose MyMemory or Google online translation, the text you submit is sent to that provider. Connection failures may route the text through our Cloudflare-hosted translation endpoint. Original document files are extracted locally and are not sent by this feature. The endpoint does not implement a document database or persistent text storage; hosting providers may retain operational logs. Provider limits and policies apply.

MyMemory privacy · Google privacy

Hosting and browser storage

The site is hosted on Cloudflare Pages. Hosting may process technical information such as IP addresses, request URLs and browser information for delivery and security. The application currently includes no advertising scripts, analytics trackers or user account system. Browser-managed caches may retain site assets and models; you can clear them through your browser's site-data settings.

Cloudflare privacy

Support and changes

Privacy questions and bug reports can be raised through our contact page. GitHub reports are public. This page will be updated if tools, storage or external services change.
